Order 
This is the f i r s t bail application filed on behalf of the applicant/accused under Section 482 of the Bhartiya Nagrik Surksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of anticipatory bail, as he is under apprehension of his arrest, in connection with Crime No.10/2024, registered at Police Station Kotwali Balaghat District Balaghat (M.P.) for the offences punishable under Sections 376(2)(n), 109, 506 read with section 34 of the IPC.

sentences.text: 2. Learned counsel appearing for applicant submitted that applicant is an old person of 60 years.
He is a Government servant.
There is no likelihood of his absconding from law.
It is submitted that there is long delay in lodging of FIR.
Incident is said to have taken place on 13.06.2022 but no report was lodged immediately.
Report was lodged after some delay i.e. on 18.06.2024.
Prosecution story is doubtful.
Applicant may be falsely 2 MCRC-33380-2024 implicated in the case.
3. Learned Govt.
Advocate appearing for the State as well as counsel appearing for objector opposed the application for grant of anticipatory bail.
It is submitted that in 164 statement, prosecutrix has narrated the incident and stated that applicant had videographed her and has taken her indecent photograph and was also blackmailing her.
Due to said reason, complaint was not lodged immediately.
4. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.

sentences.text: 5. On going through the facts of case, it is found that incident occurred on 13.06.2022.
No report of said incident was lodged.
On 13.06.2022, prosecutrix did not call for any help and did not make any hue and cry inside principal office where she is said to have been rapped.
She continued to have relationship with applicant for long.
When applicant was transferred to Baihar, she also went to Baihar.
Later on she stated that she was videographed and indecent photographs are taken therefore, she did not lodge report of incident.
6. Considering the totality of facts and circumstances of the case, anticipatory bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

7. It is directed that in the event of arrest of applicant in connection with the aforesaid crime number and the offences, he be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rs. Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Investigating Officer/Arresting Authority.
8. The applicant is directed to join the investigation immediately and 3 MCRC-33380-2024 to co-operate with the investigating agency.
